root_source_read: M2 counter/reference reconstruction primary sources and data
177C2009 p10 complex sign, later RSR experiment corroboration only
frozen_candidate: For pre-NSP Block5 receiver with level1 S-exciter reference Fstored and Xdownlink, mean received sky=(880/221)*Fstored - D. Independently use N/T-1e6 in place of D. This conditional historical processing identification is tested, not forced by the ODF label alone.
RSR_candidate: mean received sky = LO - [P(1+delta)-P(delta)] + s*fitted_baseband_frequency, delta in{0,1/2000}seconds, s in{-1,+1}; convert archived IEEE coefficients exactly to rational before subtraction of GHz-scale quantities. Delta labels are two archived phase-polynomial readings, not a fitted time shift or calibrated pipeline delay.
finite_interval_limit: One-second sinusoid fit estimates a best approximation to baseband voltage. Replacing its true interval mean phase derivative by the fitted slope is an additional local carrier-model assumption. Count interval [second,second+1] differs from sample support ending atsecond+.999; no small numerical comparison certifies a physical error budget.
all_comparisons: Record all600matchedcounts,allflagsandbothsigns/timings; no fitted bias, time shift, scale or rejected rows. Ka has no matched closed-loop downlink product here and is not independently calibrated.
